subject: Order form: invoice milestone timing, net terms exception, and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Serrano <alex.serrano@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T08:02:00+01:00
Subject: Redlines on Order Form v3 – invoice milestones, net terms, VAT

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for sending the latest Order Form. We've reviewed and attached a redline (Nimbus_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf) with three commercial asks we need clarified before we can sign:

1) Invoice milestones: we need invoices to be triggered on (a) activation (post-PO), (b) monthly usage reconciliation (first invoice pro-rated), and (c) final annual true-up. Please confirm Redwood can align invoice triggers to those deliverables and provide an example schedule.

2) Net terms: finance is pushing for Net60 rather than Net45 due to internal approval cycles. If Redwood can accept Net60 for the first 12 months, we can expedite signature.

3) VAT/tax: we're VAT-exempt for our EU research entity and have attached our certificate (Nimbus_VAT_Exemption_Certificate.pdf). Please confirm whether Redwood requires any additional tax evidence or a reverse-charge clause.

We're happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Nimbus Health

Attachments: Nimbus_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf; Nimbus_VAT_Exemption_Certificate.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T10:15:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Redlines on Order Form v3 – invoice milestones, net terms, VAT

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear redline and the VAT cert. Appreciate the level of detail.

Quick responses / next steps:
- Invoice milestones: we can map invoices to Activation / Monthly Reconciliation / Annual True-Up. I've attached a proposed invoice schedule (proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx) that maps dates and example amounts — take a look and tell me if it matches your expectations.
- Net terms: I'll escalate Net60 to finance. Looping in Ben to confirm feasibility for this deal and whether this will require a one-time credit check or internal approval.
- VAT: thanks for the certificate; legal/ops will confirm whether we need an MSA amendment or reverse-charge wording.

Kimberly / Ben — can you review Marta's redlines and the attached invoice schedule and confirm (a) acceptance of Net60 for the first 12 months, (b) required tax wording or evidence for VAT-exempt EU entities, and (c) whether we should produce an amended Order Form or an addendum to the MSA?

If we can get a legal + finance thumbs up by EOD we can send a signature-ready DocuSign link to Marta.

— Jonas
Account Director, Redwood Inference
Phone: +44 20 7000 5555

Attachments: proposed-invoice-schedule.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T13:50:00+01:00
Subject: RE: Redlines on Order Form v3 – invoice milestones, net terms, VAT

Jonas / team — reviewed Marta's redlines and the proposed schedule. Summary and recommended path:

1) Net60 request: Finance (Ben) confirmed we can approve Net60 on a limited basis for this account if we treat it as a term-level exception tied to a 12-month trial period. Require: (a) credit hold clause if invoices >60 days overdue, (b) approval recorded in the deal (I'll note in the HubSpot link). If Nimbus is comfortable with those guardrails, Legal ok to proceed.

2) Invoice milestones: Proposed schedule is reasonable. Recommend we formalize triggers in the Order Form appendix — "Invoice Triggers & Schedule" — rather than leaving them only in the SOW. This keeps billing ops clear and prevents disputes.

3) VAT / tax: Certificate included is acceptable for our records. However, we need explicit customer language in the Order Form stating: "Customer represents and warrants that it is VAT-exempt and will provide valid documentation; if the exemption is invalid, Customer remains liable for VAT." For EU customers we can also add reverse-charge language where appropriate. If Nimbus prefers reverse-charge, ask them to confirm applicable local tax authority guidance in writing.

4) Contract mechanics: We can either (A) publish an amended Order Form that incorporates the invoice schedule, Net60 term (with exception language), and the VAT representation clause, or (B) execute a short addendum. Recommendation: publish an amended Order Form (clean + redline) for signature so the record is single-file.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to confirm operational acceptance of Net60 (Ben?).
- Jonas to send the amended Order Form to Nimbus once Ben confirms; I will prepare redline-summary.docx that outlines the language edits for legal sign-off.

Ben: please confirm we can process Net60 for NW-2028-9876 and whether this requires an AR hold flag or a special payment schedule.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redline-summary.docx

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Serrano <alex.serrano@nimbushealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T15:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Redlines on Order Form v3 – invoice milestones, net terms, VAT

Thanks Jonas / Kimberly / Ben — that plan works for us. We confirm:

- Nimbus will provide the signed VAT-exemption evidence and confirm in writing the entity and legal basis for reverse-charge if we opt for that route.
- Net60 for the first 12 months is acceptable to our procurement team; we appreciate the exception.
- Please send the amended Order Form (clean + redline) for signature — we'll complete quickly once we receive the DocuSign link.

If you can include the invoice schedule in the Order Form appendix, that's ideal. Once we have the DocuSign link we'll get our finance team to sign within 48 hours.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Health

P.S. Alex will upload the VAT evidence shortly to the HubSpot deal record.
